cards.after: we-including-you will review the draft. / we-excluding-you will review the draft.
cards.caption: we-including-you includes the reader; we-excluding-you does not.
cards.claim_guard: Do not call human comprehension experimentally proven; present the distinction itself and qualify the token claim.
cards.next_action: Run form-separated comprehension after reader qualification; current caption may describe meaning, not measured superiority.

cards.after: you-one should approve the change. / you-all should approve the change.
cards.caption: you-one addresses one recipient; you-all addresses the whole group.
cards.claim_guard: Token confirmation is not a comprehension study.
cards.next_action: Confirm comprehension and keep use-versus-mention adoption caution.

cards.caption: fact-not-known means evidence is missing; choice-not-made means the decision is still pending.
cards.claim_guard: Do not imply that the marker proves an adequate search or a sound decision process.
cards.next_action: Confirm comprehension; separate missing evidence from inadequate search.

cards.after: Complete the audit, no-delegation. / Complete the audit, one-hop-delegation-allowed.
cards.caption: no-delegation forbids handoff; one-hop-delegation-allowed permits direct delegates but no further handoff.
cards.claim_guard: Do not claim compliance or comprehension from token counts.
cards.next_action: Confirm comprehension with delegation-chain attachment cells.

cards.after: The agents each-alone signed. / The agents as-one signed.
cards.caption: each-alone means every member acts separately; as-one means the group acts collectively.
cards.claim_guard: Do not present a settled comprehension effect until the adverse original is independently resolved.
cards.next_action: Resolve the adverse comprehension original with a fresh disjoint instrument.

cards.after: The file was deleted by-unknown. / The file was deleted by-withheld.
cards.caption: by-unknown says the author does not know the actor; by-withheld says the author knows but does not disclose.
cards.claim_guard: Do not claim a comprehension advantage while the registered evidence conflicts.
cards.next_action: Adjudicate conflicting evidence separately by omission pole.

cards.caption: start-by constrains when work begins; complete-by constrains when it finishes.
cards.claim_guard: Do not claim measured benefit or settled compression.
cards.next_action: Adjudicate deadline-event comprehension and compression conflicts.

cards.after: Choose red or-both blue. / Choose red not-both blue.
cards.caption: or-both allows both alternatives; not-both forbids choosing both.
cards.claim_guard: Do not imply token efficiency or an overall measured win.
cards.next_action: Resolve measured-inconclusive evidence before claiming a win.

cards.before: Did the job not fail? Yes.
cards.after: Did the job not fail? true-as-worded.
cards.caption: true-as-worded and false-as-worded answer the sentence exactly as phrased, including negation.
cards.claim_guard: Do not call the overall proposal experimentally supported.
cards.next_action: Resolve measured-inconclusive evidence before claiming a win.

cards.after: The meeting moved-earlier to Tuesday. / The meeting moved-later to Tuesday.
cards.caption: moved-earlier and moved-later make the direction of a schedule change explicit.
cards.claim_guard: Do not present it as ratified or evidence-ready; comprehension and tag-fidelity work remain incomplete.
cards.next_action: Complete tag fidelity and one disjoint form/comparator comprehension settlement.

cards.after: Affected: API, worker, among-others. / Affected: API, worker, and-no-others.
cards.caption: among-others leaves a list open; and-no-others says the list is complete.
cards.claim_guard: Do not present it as ratified or measured; it is seconded and its adverse token original is still unconfirmed.
cards.next_action: Confirm the adverse token price, then run whole/part and attachment comparators.

cards.after: some-or-all workers may retry. / some-but-not-all workers may retry.
cards.caption: some-or-all leaves room for every member; some-but-not-all excludes the all-members case.
cards.claim_guard: Do not imply empirical support; the fresh adverse comprehension result and its instrument diagnosis remain live.
cards.next_action: Do not dilute the fresh adverse result; diagnose or amend.

cards.after: The worker may-as-permission retry. / The worker may-as-possibility retry.
cards.caption: may-as-permission authorizes an action; may-as-possibility says the action could happen.
cards.claim_guard: Do not imply its current evidence contract is coherent until the bounded token prerequisite is on the live surface.
cards.next_action: Repair the token contract before more comprehension spend.

cards.before: A reviewer must approve the release.
cards.after: one-or-more(reviewer): approve the release. / exactly-one(reviewer): approve the release.
cards.caption: Say whether one participant is the minimum or the exact limit.
cards.claim_guard: Do not call this measured, ratified, or comprehension-improving while it awaits an independent second and both evidence metrics.
cards.next_action: Obtain an independent semantic second; then file the frozen token packet and retain the sealed comprehension carrier.

claim_rule: Semantic captions may explain the registered distinction. Superiority, comprehension, adoption, and popularity claims require their own live evidence.
